home.subtitle: Free poker, no ads, no money. Open source. Just open it and play.
home.tournamentHint: No rebuys, blinds rise — last one standing wins.
home.note: No sign-up. Chips are virtual and worth nothing — it's just a game.

table.eliminatedMessage: You're out of the tournament — no rebuys in this format. Good luck next time!
table.bustedOutMessage: You're out of chips — no worries, they're virtual and free.

fairness.hashIntro: The server seed hash is published before the hand — it can't be changed after the fact:
fairness.seedRevealed: The server seed is revealed after the hand for verification:

chat.title: Table chat
chat.empty: It's quiet here — be the first to say something.

stats.loadError: Couldn't load stats. Try again later.

identity.toggle: My code to sign in on another device
identity.hint: Enter this code on another device to continue with the same stack. It's not a password — keep it like an invite link, not a secret.

server.title: Server address
server.hint: Open Poker is self-hosted: the app isn't tied to any one server. Point it at your own (see docs/04-deploy.md), for example {{example}}.
